latin: Per duplicem Venerem, de qua in Symposio Platonis, nihil aliud intelligere debemus_quam duplicem pulchritudinem, sensibilem et intelligibilem.
translation: By the twofold Venus spoken of in Plato's Symposium we ought to understand nothing other than a twofold beauty, sensible and intelligible.
